<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F7F7F7"/>
  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="21" y="27" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="316" y1="25" x2="316" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="321" y1="25" x2="321" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="25" x2="326" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="25" x2="331" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="347" cy="21" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="21" x2="350" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="17" x2="353" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="363" y="14" width="24" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="366" y="17" width="17" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="387" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="52" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="29,70 21,76 29,82" fill="none" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="21" y1="76" x2="38" y2="76" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="195" y="81" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Privacy and Security</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="95" x2="390" y2="95" stroke="#D8D8D8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- section header -->
  <text x="20" y="119" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#8E8E93">PRIVACY</text>

  <!-- privacy card shadow and body -->
  <rect x="16" y="132" width="358" height="278" rx="10" fill="#D8D8D8" opacity="0.35"/>
  <rect x="16" y="130" width="358" height="278" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- phone row icon -->
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="145" width="22" height="30" rx="5" fill="#007AFF"/>
    <line x1="35" y1="149" x2="45" y2="149" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="170" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="67" y="153" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Phone Number</text>
    <text x="67" y="171" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">Who can see my number</text>
    <text x="330" y="160" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#8E8E93">Nobody</text>
    <polyline points="353,153 358,158 353,163" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="67" y1="184" x2="358" y2="184" stroke="#D8D8D8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- last seen -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="40" cy="211" r="14" fill="#67CE00"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="211" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="211" x2="40" y2="206" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="211" x2="44" y2="214" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="67" y="209" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Last Seen & Online</text>
    <text x="67" y="227" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">Your activity status</text>
    <text x="330" y="216" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#8E8E93">Everybody</text>
    <polyline points="353,207 358,212 353,217" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="67" y1="240" x2="358" y2="240" stroke="#D8D8D8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- photos -->
  <g>
    <rect x="27" y="253" width="26" height="22" rx="4" fill="#FF5E00"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="264" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="258" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="67" y="260" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Profile Photos</text>
    <text x="67" y="278" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">Who can see your profile picture</text>
    <text x="330" y="267" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#8E8E93">My Contacts</text>
    <polyline points="353,258 358,263 353,268" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="67" y1="292" x2="358" y2="292" stroke="#D8D8D8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- calls -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="40" cy="316" r="14" fill="#21C004"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="310" x2="38" y2="314" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="318" x2="46" y2="322" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <line x1="37" y1="313" x2="43" y2="319" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <text x="67" y="313" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Calls</text>
    <text x="67" y="331" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">Who can call you</text>
    <text x="330" y="320" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#8E8E93">My Contacts</text>
    <polyline points="353,311 358,316 353,321" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="67" y1="344" x2="358" y2="344" stroke="#D8D8D8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- forwarded -->
  <g>
    <rect x="27" y="356" width="26" height="23" rx="5" fill="#8E8E93"/>
    <polyline points="34,367 44,367 40,363" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="44,367 40,371" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="67" y="361" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Forwarded Messages</text>
    <text x="67" y="379" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">Who can add a link to your account</text>
    <text x="330" y="368" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#8E8E93">Everybody</text>
    <polyline points="353,359 358,364 353,369" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- groups section -->
  <text x="20" y="433" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#8E8E93">GROUPS AND CHANNELS</text>
  <rect x="16" y="444" width="358" height="54" rx="10" fill="#D8D8D8" opacity="0.35"/>
  <rect x="16" y="442" width="358" height="54" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="469" r="14" fill="#037EE5"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="466" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="466" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="476" x2="40" y2="476" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="476" x2="50" y2="476" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="67" y="466" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Groups & Channels</text>
  <text x="67" y="484" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">Who can add you</text>
  <text x="330" y="473" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#8E8E93">My Contacts</text>
  <polyline points="353,464 358,469 353,474" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- additional privacy -->
  <text x="20" y="523" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#8E8E93">SECURITY</text>
  <rect x="16" y="534" width="358" height="105" rx="10" fill="#D8D8D8" opacity="0.35"/>
  <rect x="16" y="532" width="358" height="105" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="547" width="24" height="22" rx="5" fill="#636366"/>
    <rect x="34" y="553" width="12" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="36,553 36,550 44,550 44,553" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="67" y="557" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Blocked Users</text>
    <text x="67" y="575" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">3 accounts blocked</text>
    <polyline points="353,550 358,555 353,560" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="67" y1="586" x2="358" y2="586" stroke="#D8D8D8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <circle cx="40" cy="610" r="14" fill="#FFA800"/>
    <rect x="34" y="603" width="12" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="37" y1="600" x2="43" y2="600" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="67" y="607" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Active Sessions</text>
    <text x="67" y="625" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">2 devices connected</text>
    <polyline points="353,600 358,605 353,610" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- account deletion -->
  <text x="20" y="664" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#8E8E93">ACCOUNT</text>
  <rect x="16" y="674" width="358" height="70" rx="10" fill="#D8D8D8" opacity="0.35"/>
  <rect x="16" y="672" width="358" height="70" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="30" y="697" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#000000">If Away For</text>
  <text x="30" y="718" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#8E8E93">Automatically delete my account</text>
  <text x="347" y="705" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#8E8E93">1 year</text>
  <polyline points="353,694 358,699 353,704" fill="none" stroke="#AEAEB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="50" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#D8D8D8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- contacts -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="778" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#8E8E93" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="39" cy="788" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#8E8E93" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="39" y="804" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#8E8E93">Contacts</text>
  </g>
  <!-- calls -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="117" cy="782" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#8E8E93" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="112" y1="777" x2="122" y2="787" stroke="#8E8E93" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="117" y="804" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#8E8E93">Calls</text>
  </g>
  <!-- chats -->
  <g>
    <rect x="186" y="773" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="#8E8E93"/>
    <polygon points="190,789 195,789 191,793" fill="#8E8E93"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="774" r="8" fill="#FE3B30"/>
    <text x="214" y="777" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="9" fill="#FFFFFF">4</text>
    <text x="195" y="804" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#8E8E93">Chats</text>
  </g>
  <!-- settings active -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="312" cy="782" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="312" cy="782" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="311" y="769" width="2" height="5" fill="#007AFF"/>
    <rect x="311" y="790" width="2" height="5" fill="#007AFF"/>
    <rect x="299" y="781" width="5" height="2" fill="#007AFF"/>
    <rect x="320" y="781" width="5" height="2" fill="#007AFF"/>
    <text x="312" y="804" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#007AFF">Settings</text>
  </g>
  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="128" y="827" width="134" height="5" rx="100" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
